scope: Background music and completion chime audio-mode compatibility; no UI, permissions, pricing or purchase flow changes

rootCause.effect: ExpoAudio iOS rejects setAudioModeAsync before the background music player is created
rootCause.nativeErrorReproduced: Impossible audio mode: playsInSilentMode == false and duckOthers == true cannot be set on iOS
rootCause.priorTestGap: Music mocks accepted any mode. Completion-mode assertions inside an async function were caught by the production fail-soft handler and therefore did not fail the test.

preserved: Global sound preference and independent Music mute/None controls
Recording/private-audio focus suspension and stale-setup cancellation
Free Lofi / authoritative Plus entitlement for premium tracks
Existing selection queue, rollback, retry and completion-chime deduplication

iosNative.environment: Installed ExpoAudio native module in the isolated com.novame.localsecureqa app, iOS 26.2 simulator; local-only QA server and real bundled audio files
iosNative.limitations: Native decoding/playback state and advancing media time were verified at zero test volume. Physical-device speaker output and physical silent-switch toggling were not exercised. Recording focus and navigation lifecycle are covered by automated native-boundary regressions, not a new microphone recording session.

deployment.note: The previously prepared initial-care migration 247 is separate and has not been executed by this task.

cleanup: Dedicated simulator and localhost-only QA server stopped after verification; no production account, purchase, upload or database writes performed.
